```instr
instrument t2_sans_collimation_optimized
{
    // Parameters to optimize
    declare r_pin1 = 0.005; // Initial radius of first pinhole (m)
    declare r_pin2 = 0.005; // Initial radius of second pinhole (m)

    // Source
    Source_simple(
        name = "source",
        xwidth = 0.02,
        yheight = 0.02,
        lambda0 = 6.0,
        dlambda = 0.05,
        ncount = 1e6,
        seed = 123456
    )

    // First pinhole collimator
    Aperture_cylinder(
        name = "pinhole1",
        radius = r_pin1,
        z = 3.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0
    )

    // Monitor after first pinhole
    Monitor_nD(
        name = "monitor1",
        xwidth = 0.02,
        yheight = 0.02,
        nx = 100,
        ny = 100,
        z = 3.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0,
        restore_neutron = 1
    )

    // Second pinhole collimator
    Aperture_cylinder(
        name = "pinhole2",
        radius = r_pin2,
        z = 6.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0
    )

    // Monitor after second pinhole
    Monitor_nD(
        name = "monitor2",
        xwidth = 0.02,
        yheight = 0.02,
        nx = 100,
        ny = 100,
        z = 6.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0,
        restore_neutron = 1
    )

    // Sample
    Sample_component(
        name = "sample",
        z = 9.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0
    )

    // Beamstop
    Beamstop(
        name = "beamstop",
        radius = 0.001,
        z = 9.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0
    )

    // Final detector
    Monitor_nD(
        name = "detector",
        xwidth = 0.6,
        yheight = 0.6,
        nx = 100,
        ny = 100,
        z = 12.0,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 0.0
    )

    // Define the instrument chain
    source
    -> pinhole1
    -> monitor1
    -> pinhole2
    -> monitor2
    -> sample
    -> beamstop
    -> detector
}
```
